520	Again, so that after 120 years of Rav Shach there will be someone fit to instruct others to go out
521	to work, that is why I'm staying.
522	Because if I go out to work, I won't be a Torah scholar.
523	And if I won't be a Torah scholar, I won't be able to give the instruction to go out and work.
524	So that is why he stayed.
525	Now, on Purim, a few students from the yeshiva came to Rav Shach.
526	They sat with him, Torah thoughts, and there was joy.
527	Suddenly Rabbi Shlomo Lorincz walked in.
528	Do you remember him?
529	He was a Knesset member, he was also a deputy minister, he had...
530	What?
531	Chairman of the Finance Committee.
532	Chairman of the Finance Committee.
533	He came in, and the boys understood right away: Rabbi Lorincz came in, a Knesset member, so they have to
534	vacate his place, in any case, a person of standing, came in.
535	So they got up to vacate the seat for him to come in; he came with a mishloach manot.
536	Rav Shach signaled to them: sit.
537	He took Rabbi Lorincz to the kitchen.
538	He gave him a different mishloach manot, escorted him outside, did everything properly.
539	He came back and told them how important he is, how much he brings merit to the many, and how much depends on him.
540	But yeshiva students who sit and learn, their level is greater,
541	and their standing is more important.
542	And he stayed to speak with those young students, to show them they are more important than that
543	Knesset member.
544	And therefore, the Gemara says in Tractate Megillah, page 16b:
545	Torah study is greater than saving lives. What does it mean that Torah study is greater
546	than saving lives?
547	The Ateret Zahav says, Yoreh De'ah, Siman 251, subsection 6, Laws of Tzedakah:
548	Suppose there is a suicide terrorist now, may HaShem have mercy, who wants to enter
549	the mall there, Malha Mall,
550	wants to enter the mall and carry out an attack, and the security guard discovers him, immediately pounces
551	on him, takes him to the floor, ties his hands, let's make it a story, okay,
552	and saves all the people in Malha Mall, they will let him light a
553	torch on Independence Day and he will receive a citizen's, I don't know how you say it, some medal
554	of honor. But a yeshiva student, or the person who sits here and learns
555	in the synagogue, on the street, at that same time, the Ateret Zahav says, in Heaven he receives a reward much
556	higher than that security guard who saved hundreds of people. You have
557	that, how do you say, the plumber,
558	this plumber, yes, from the plane, I don't remember his name,
559	this plumber who saved the 170 passengers there on the plane.
